posts.title: The Performance Cost of RwLock in Our Read-Heavy Workload
posts.description: How per-item RwLock reads became expensive in our read-heavy workload, how using lock-free has improved performance, and where a simple RwLock remained a good fit.

posts.title: Tokio Gives Progress, Not Ordering: Scheduling 1M Tasks
posts.description: How spawning 1M Tokio tasks preserved throughput while letting polling order drift from event submission order, and why task creation needs an application-level bound.

posts.title: Your Rust Service Isn't Leaking, It Could Be the Allocator
posts.description: How we diagnosed unexplained memory staying pinned near the top of our container limit in a Rust event stream processor — not a leak or fragmentation, and why the allocator matters.
